subject: Lodestar Settings: multi-provider AI + expanded model list incl Fable
description: Currently only Anthropic. Add provider selector (Anthropic + OpenAI + Google/Gemini, extensible) with per-provider API key fields (extend IMP-6 key mgmt). Provider-aware model selection. Anthropic list MUST add Fable (claude-fable-5) — currently missing — alongside Opus 4.8 (claude-opus-4-8), Sonnet 5 (claude-sonnet-5), Haiku 4.5 (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001). Extends IMP-7. Backend provider abstraction may escalate from Fable to Opus if needed.
